response.overview: Rakta Charitra is a biographical tale of Paritala Ravi from Andhra Pradesh, a prime suspect accused in a number of murder cases. It is the story of a man's phenomenal rise to power and a story of the most intense blood curdling conflict ever heard of between two individuals. The story is also the ultimate statement on the often heard disastrous consequences of a fatal mixture of caste, crime, family feuds and politics.
response.title: Rakhta Charitra (రక్త చరిత్ర)
